title: Reconnect Origami semantic state, source memory, Fold/Unfold, evidence and visual control boundaries

before.state: Virtual Memory, Fixed Carrier, evidence reduction and historical semantic/perceptual contracts existed, but the alpha.3 semantic intent was still fragmented across contracts, reference code and OHF laboratory tracks. Literal/exact transport could be tested independently while first-class Context, declarative Rules, semantic statuses, observation, temporal contracts and semantic Fold/Unfold were not one executable path.

after.state: Semantic Spine R1 provides an executable deterministic state core with S_(t+1)=F(S_t,C_t,R), distinct PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN/INHIBITED/CANCELLED statuses, declarative contradictions, higher-order participants, temporal observation contracts, exhaustive finite exploration oracle, semantic Fold with unresolved alternatives, selective Unfold with touched-address accounting, exact-source/semantic separation, Virtual Memory projection, evidence-backed canonical claim promotion and Fixed Carrier binding to external canonical memory.

preserved_external_work.tlaloc: Tlaloc 6.0.0-alpha.11 remains the existing Canonical Document IR/OCR, Tlaloque orchestration, CanonicalState, Merkle exact plane, ERA H0-H5 and tlaloc.origami-tools.r2 provider. Semantic Spine R1 does not duplicate or replace that pipeline.
preserved_external_work.tonal: Existing Fixed Carrier R2 candidate composition and empirical promotion gates remain valid and unpromoted until their external evidence gates pass.
preserved_external_work.ohf: Perception Lab and Native/Hybrid research assets remain evidence-gated and are not discarded.
